text:
Rina Kapoor: Quick sync: customers asked for a small, low-risk Optimize toolkit pilot (batching, caching, quant recs, eval-triggered alerts). Need scope by EOD.

Sam Lopez: Keep it tight. Two workload buckets (chat short, doc long) + single model family. That gives clear signal.

Priya Chen: Eval-alerting must ship with labeled baseline, seeded regressions, and clear rollback rules. Customers expect reproducibility.

Ethan Moore: Runtime update: batching + prefix caching are stable in canary. Quant recommendations need a persistent profile store + advisor API; estimate 2 dev-weeks for a minimal store.

Alex Zhang: Ops: advisory-only for pilot (no auto-apply). Add per-tenant kill-switch, percent-rollout slider, and monitoring that auto-disables on >12% p99 regression.

Rina Kapoor: Proposed pilot: 3 tenants (2 midmarket + 1 enterprise), model redwood-verif-7B, advisory-only opt-in, gates: quant-profile store, eval baseline + seeded regressions, per-tenant kill-switch, short rationale text in recommendation card. Timeline: kickoff in 2 weeks, gate review in 6 weeks.

Sam Lopez: I'll confirm pilot customers and data permissions.

Priya Chen: I'll prepare eval prompt set and seed regressions; propose sample=400 checks/day, seed=40 per tenant. Auto-rollback if core metric drops >3 points for 6 hours.

Ethan Moore: I'll draft the advisor API and storage schema. Will return recommendations as JSON with fields: model_family, recommended {batch_size, cache_policy, quant_profile}, confidence, rationale.

Alex Zhang: I'll add runbook entries, monitoring alerts, and deploy-bot checks to block rollout without kill-switch.

Rina Kapoor: If no objections, locking scope by EOD and notifying sales/CS for outreach.

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled 1805557800 - 1805558400; will post deploy events.

Sam Lopez: :thumbsup:

Priya Chen: Noted.

Ethan Moore: 44d

Alex Zhang: 44d will follow up with PR.
